headline: Finnish and European health technology is growing, with record Finnish exports, strong wearables and diagnostics deals, and EU device-rule reform still unresolved. This week's refresh found little new news.

metrics.label: European medtech market
metrics.value: about EUR 173 billion; Europe about 25.5% of world market; devices +5.6%/yr and IVD +3.6%/yr over 10 years

metrics.label: EU-27 manufacture of medical and dental instruments (C32.5): enterprises / persons employed
metrics.value: 62,000 enterprises; about 580,000 employed; wages EUR 23.1 billion

metrics.label: Finland C32.5 net turnover
metrics.value: EUR 447.5 million (up 17.4% from EUR 381.1 million); 434 enterprises; 2,529 employed

metrics.label: Finnish health technology product exports
metrics.value: EUR 2.79 billion (up 8%), about EUR 0.92 billion to the US; excludes software

metrics.label: Business Finland health funding
metrics.value: more than EUR 65 million to health projects (of EUR 785 million total); Health 360 Finland EUR 20 million per year

metrics.label: EIC Accelerator 2027 budget
metrics.value: EUR 428 million Open plus EUR 150 million Challenges

signals.title: MDR/IVDR revision: no official confirmation of December votes
signals.detail: Rechecked 2026-11-25: no source confirmed a SANT vote on 3 Dec 2026 or a plenary on 14 Dec. A Commission update lists the comitology vote as TBC. Current rules continue to apply; other sources expect adoption in Q2-Q3 2027.

signals.title: Finnish Treat raises EUR 3 million pre-seed
signals.detail: AI patient intake plus doctor consultations; led by byFounders and Illusian (search summary only; the page did not load).

signals.title: Aalto shows five health technology teams at Slush (18-19 Nov)
signals.detail: The five pre-commercialisation teams show on 2026-11-19: Brain-Informed (assesses motor recovery after stroke), Vesti (vestibular-stimulation biomarker), ORCA (machine vision for joint replacement surgery), EyeInsight (specialist-level detection of eye disease for front-line eye care) and ShadowEye (AI-enhanced low-light optical detectors).

signals.title: ERC Proof of Concept 2027 call opens
signals.detail: EUR 60 million in total, about 400 grants of EUR 150,000. Cut-offs are 2027-03-10 and 2027-09-16. Only ERC grant holders can apply. With no Research Council of Finland PoC call in 2027, this matters more for Aalto ERC holders.

signals.title: Revenio Q3: sales more than double after Visionix acquisition, guidance narrowed
signals.detail: Q3 net sales EUR 58.8 million (up 127.5%), January-September EUR 125.4 million (up 59.8%). Growth came from Visionix, consolidated since June 2026; other reporting describes organic sales as flat. Full-year 2026 guidance was narrowed to EUR 190-200 million from EUR 190-205 million. A rights issue of about EUR 80 million was oversubscribed and repaid the acquisition bridge loan.

signals.title: Oura agrees to buy Counsel Health for USD 625 million
signals.detail: Cash deal for an AI primary care company, expected to close before the end of 2026 subject to regulatory approvals. It follows the postponed IPO. Oura reports fiscal 2026 revenue of about USD 1.75 billion (up 92%, preliminary).

signals.title: MDR/IVDR revision: Parliament hearing with MedTech Europe; vote date still unconfirmed
signals.detail: A SANT committee vote in early December and a plenary in mid-December have been forecast. Other sources expect the plenary vote in Q1 2027 and talks with member states in spring 2027. No official confirmation was found. The AI Act overlap is the main dispute.

signals.title: Oura agrees to buy Counsel Health for USD 625 million and reports USD 1.75 billion fiscal-year revenue
signals.detail: All-cash deal for an AI virtual primary care company, expected to close before the end of 2026. Fiscal Q4 (to 30 Sep 2026) revenue was USD 533 million (up 153%) and FY2026 revenue about USD 1.75 billion (up 92%). The IPO is still postponed.

signals.title: EIC Accelerator 2027 opens
signals.detail: Short proposals can be submitted continuously until 2027-12-16. Full-proposal cut-offs are 2027-01-20, 2027-03-17, 2027-09-01 and 2027-11-04 (now confirmed on the EIC site). Budget is EUR 428 million Open plus EUR 150 million Challenges.

signals.title: European Parliament hearing on MDR/IVDR reform; SANT committee vote still unconfirmed
signals.detail: A hearing was held in Brussels with MedTech Europe. A SANT committee vote has been reported for 2026-12-03 and an indicative plenary date of 2026-12-14, but neither is confirmed in the Legislative Observatory. Other sources expect the vote in early 2027. Current MDR/IVDR rules still apply.

signals.title: Oura to buy AI primary care company Counsel Health for USD 625 million
signals.detail: All-cash deal, reported to close before the end of 2026 (one outlet says 2027). It moves Oura from wearables into medical care services, weeks after it postponed its IPO indefinitely. Press reports give Oura quarterly revenue of USD 533 million to 30 September, up 153%. Figures are from news reports; the article itself could not be opened.

signals.title: Nightingale Health gets first New York State test approvals
signals.detail: First laboratory developed tests approved by New York State. Other November items: distribution deals in the UK and the Netherlands (4-10 Nov) and AGM resolutions (5 Nov). Latest inside-information release found: a USD 1 million proteomics agreement with Alzheimer's Research UK (2026-10-28).

signals.title: Nightingale Health gets first New York State test approvals; Netherlands launch followed on 2026-11-10
signals.detail: Further news: a UK longevity clinic deal (2026-11-04) and a UK Biobank neurodegeneration study with Alamar (2026-11-02).

signals.title: Nexstim appoints CTO and wins Finnish NBS 6 order
signals.detail: Ville Saarainen is the new CTO. The order for an NBS 6 system came from a Finnish hospital on 2026-10-29. A letter of intent with Sinaptica on Alzheimer's treatment awaits definitive agreements by end of 2026.

signals.title: Aalto ranks 3rd in Europe for university spinout funding
signals.detail: Spinouts raised over EUR 500 million in H1 2026, mostly ICEYE. Eight research-based spinouts so far in 2026, with a target of 20 per year.

signals.title: EIC Pathfinder Open 2027 opens 2026-11-25
signals.detail: EUR 166 million; stage 1 deadline 2027-02-25, stage 2 2027-09-16. Needs a consortium of 3 or more entities in 3 countries. Open from today.

signals.title: Horizon Europe HLTH 2027 calls opened
signals.detail: Point-of-care diagnostics (EUR 39.3 million) and AI predictive biomarkers (EUR 44.2 million); stage 1 deadline 2027-02-17.

signals.title: Bittium Medical segment returns to profit and launches Faros Pro ECG
signals.detail: Medical net sales were EUR 5.1 million in Q3 (up 18.5%) and EUR 15.1 million for January-September, with operating profit of EUR 1.1 million against a loss a year earlier. Faros Pro long-term ECG and the EasyFlex patch launched in August 2026. Talks with strategic partners for the sleep business continue, with first results expected by the end of 2026.

signals.title: Horizon Europe HLTH 2027 calls open
signals.detail: Calls include point-of-care diagnostics, AI biomarkers, disabilities and independent living, and virtual human twins.

signals.title: Horizon Europe HLTH 2027 calls open
signals.detail: Calls opened including point-of-care diagnostics (two-stage, deadline 2027-09-16) and disabilities and independent living (deadline 2027-02-17).

signals.title: Nexstim signs letter of intent with Sinaptica for 10-year exclusive Alzheimer's arrangement
signals.detail: The planned worldwide arrangement covers a precision neuromodulation system for Alzheimer's disease and MCI, and depends on definitive agreements being signed before the end of 2026. Therapy system deliveries doubled to 6 in January-September (3 a year earlier); 17 systems are in the order backlog. Nexstim also reports growing interest in its system for brain-computer interface research.

signals.title: Nexstim Q3 2026 business update
signals.detail: 154 systems installed worldwide, 57 of them in the US. Joint neurosurgery marketing with Brainlab continues. A 10-system NBS 6 distributor order was announced in July 2026.

signals.title: UK confirms long-term acceptance of CE-marked medical devices
signals.detail: The MHRA said Great Britain will keep accepting CE-marked devices and IVDs with no additional approval route. This removes the need for a separate UKCA route for EU-certified spin-off products. No effective date was given in the release.

signals.title: Nexstim and Brainlab install navigated TMS at Hospital da Luz Lisboa
signals.detail: Expands Nexstim's presence in Portugal. A search also showed a EUR 5 million investment from Eiffel and Brainlab announced 2026-05-13 (listing only; not read in full).

signals.title: Stryker invests about USD 400 million in CMR Surgical with an option to acquire
signals.detail: Preferred equity investment in the Cambridge (UK) surgical robotics company, with an exclusive option to buy 100% later and exclusive US sales rights for the Versius system. It shows large strategics still paying for European surgical robotics.

signals.title: MedTech Europe publishes 'European Medical Technology in Figures 2026'
signals.detail: New edition of the sector data hub. I could not read the headline figures.

signals.title: Oura postpones US IPO
signals.detail: Oura set terms (50 million shares at USD 40-44, valuation about USD 15.6 billion, Nasdaq ticker OURA) but a BusinessDay headline of 29 Sept reports it postponed the listing. I saw only the headline, not the article text, so the reason and any new date are unconfirmed.
